chapter: New York, Henderson and Charlie Johnson
title: Upstate New York tours, Dr. Steve Canelli, and money trouble with Hyder
summary: He recalls his Watertown doctor Steve Canelli, then says Hyder's tours stopped paying and he left in 1929 after passing through New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Did you go up into New England? New York State? Up that way at all?

Not then. We -- later we did, went up there to -- (laughs). I'm glad you asked me that. I've got a favorite doctor who lived up there. We used to go up to New York. Uh -- I never heard of it until I met him, before we went up there. That's why I'm trying to remember this doggone name of this -- aw, come on Herman.

Naw, it's a small place. That's what I'm think -- but he was from there. He said oh, that's my town. He operated on me when I had -- I had a thing in my mouth a couple of years ago from smoking, and he had to go up in the roof of my mouth and operate. He was a very nice man.
Uh, he's in Syracuse. I'm close, in a minute. Steve -- I'm talking about you.
Uh-huh. Aw man, he -- I understand before he used to sing, his father played -- no, he played piano and his father sang. Yeah, the two of them had a ball. You know?
Watertown, New York, Dr. Steve Canelli.
Aw, he would love that. Aw he was -- he's such a great guy. And a good pal and a good friend and all that. But we were up there during that -- and, you know,

coming in and out. I don't see -- New York state, into Pennsylvania, and for some reason we came down to New York, and it -- well, things weren't panning out like they should have. In other words, moneywise, you know.
How long had you been with Doc Hyder?

Well, let's see, just when I joined Doc must have been, what, '27, '28. And I worked there with him in '29, you know, because I was in the Standard Theater, and as I said, the money -- money was no good. So we came into New York for something, we came through New York. We didn't play in New York, no, no. And we come to --
